description: Retrieve current market prices and historical OHLCV data for supported forex pairs, cryptocurrencies and US equities. Check trading hours, market opening status and holiday calendars in the same conversation. Connect your SiftingIO account through a read-only authorization; there is no need to paste an API key into ChatGPT. Data is retrieved on request, not streamed continuously. Available markets, historical depth and request limits depend on your SiftingIO plan. SiftingIO provides market data, not investment advice, and cannot place trades, transfer funds or change your account settings.

defaultPrompt: Show the latest EUR/USD bid and ask, with the timestamp.
Show the last five completed one-minute EUR/USD candles, including OHLCV and UTC timestamps.
Is the forex market open now, and what are its regular weekly hours in UTC?
